name: berth_queue
description: Berths (MECHANICS §9.3, D-051): two ships sail with planks from 12 and 13 tiles west of its harbour (D-058 §5) to an island whose level-1 Trading Post has one berth. Ship 1 (20 planks) arrives after 12 s, takes the berth and unloads at once (10 s + 20 x 0.2 s = 14 s); ship 2 (50 planks) arrives after 13 s and waits (waiting_for_berth, its cargo aboard) until the berth frees at 26 s; the run ends 1 ms before that grant.
